content: Rahul Jain calls insurance agent Sunita Agarwal to confirm that his home policy HC-2026-0456 is fully set up following his recent kitchen remodel. Sunita confirms that the kitchen renovations are covered under the extended water-damage clause and that the auto-debit for the premium is already established. Sunita successfully activates the policy during the call and informs Rahul that a confirmation email will be sent shortly.

action_items: Send policy confirmation email to the customer
